blindSummary: This state/province is one of six units (with five other states/provinces) that have enacted no legal gender-recognition procedure at all - an international human-rights organisation, March 2025, against a national tally of 22 of 32 states/provinces having legislated one. The organisation's dedicated March 2024 report on this state/province, co-produced with a local inclusion centre, documented that the absence keeps trans people's identity documents permanently mismatched and exposes them to police and institutional mistreatment - document mismatch being the practical trigger for police questioning of a visible visitor. A widely circulated January 2023 claim that this state/province added a criminal 'anti-eccentricity' provision failed the dossier's three-source verification and is not treated as a finding.
